conclusion: not-clean: three driver-only matrix gaps permit capture through a substituted or rebound exact HistoricalStudyVerifier, or after an unbound-driver refusal

inherited_open_findings.consequence: Still blocks whole F5a and F3/F5b; this packet neither resolves nor relabels it.

findings.summary: The matrix does not require refusal when the held exact HistoricalStudyVerifier is replaced with a different exact HistoricalStudyVerifier.
findings.reproducer: Construct with bound verifier A, substitute bound verifier B, then capture; an implementation that checks only type(held) is HistoricalStudyVerifier can capture through B, contrary to the contract's original-instance delegation.
findings.required_correction: Require original-instance identity preservation/recheck and a B-substitution refusal test.

findings.summary: The matrix does not require refusal when an exact HistoricalStudyVerifier instance's capture attribute is rebound to broker.capture.
findings.reproducer: Before driver construction, set verifier.capture = broker.capture; self._verifier.capture(...) can write CAPTURED without the HistoricalStudyVerifier bind/spend gates.
findings.required_correction: Require unbound HistoricalStudyVerifier.capture(held, ...) delegation and a rebinding refusal/no-CAPTURED test.

findings.summary: The retry row omits Driver(unbound_hsv).capture and permits an implementation to fall back to the broker after HistoricalStudyVerifier refuses.
findings.reproducer: Call the driver with an unbound verifier; a catch-and-fallback to _authority.capture passes the valid-driver and direct-F4-broker cases yet writes CAPTURED after refusal.
findings.required_correction: Require driver refusal/no-CAPTURED for an unbound HSV, then separately prove direct F4 broker capture remains callable.
